title: carpesium nepalense var. glandulosum
intro: Carpesium nepalense var. glandulosum, commonly known as the "Glandular Himalayan Wormwood", is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family, native to the Himalayan region. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues, reduce fever, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Carpesium nepalense var. glandulosum include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit sedative effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
